sentence: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I— / I took the one less traveled by, / And that has made all the difference.

source.author: Robert Frost
source.detail: 诗的最后一节（第 18–20 行），收录于诗集 Mountain Interval

translation: 林中分出两条路，而我——我选了人迹更少的那一条，从此一切都不一样了。
grammar: 主干拆解：三个分句——Two roads（主）diverged（谓，不及物）in a wood；I（主）took（谓）the one（宾）；that（主）has made（谓）all the difference（宾）。and 把它们串起来，读起来像一口气讲完的回忆。
重点一：the one less traveled by 是“代词 + 过去分词短语后置定语”。the one 代替 the road，避免重复；less traveled by 相当于 that was less traveled by（被走得更少的），分词短语较长时放在名词后面。句末的 by 不能省，因为 travel by a road 里 by 是介词，变成被动/分词后介词留在句尾。
重点二：has made 用现在完成时。took 是过去的一次选择，has made 强调这个选择的影响一直延续到现在——“过去的动作 + 至今的结果”，正是现在完成时最典型的用法。
小细节：and I— / I took 的重复和破折号是诗人故意的停顿，模仿人在回忆时的迟疑，日常写作中不必模仿。

vocab.meaning: （道路、线条）分叉；（意见、观点）出现分歧
vocab.example: The two branches diverged after the 2.0 release.

vocab.meaning: 走的人更少的；比喻少有人选择的
vocab.collocation: the road less traveled；a less-traveled path
vocab.example: He chose the road less traveled and became a hardware engineer.

vocab.meaning: 起决定性作用；带来根本的不同
vocab.collocation: make a big difference；make no difference；make all the difference to/in sth
vocab.example: A good debugger makes all the difference when you're chasing a timing bug.

vocab.meaning: 树林（常用复数 woods）；也指木头
vocab.collocation: in the woods；a walk in the wood
vocab.example: We got lost in the woods behind the village.

note: 小练习：用 make all the difference 造一个和你工作有关的句子，比如“One extra pull-up resistor made all the difference.”（多加一个上拉电阻，问题就彻底解决了）。另外，这首诗其实带点自嘲：诗里前文说两条路“really about the same”，“人迹更少”是事后回想时赋予的意义，读原诗会更有意思。
